bds_runtime_status: expected from package; verify with the matching Endstone runtime
qualification_required: An Endstone SDK and runtime that support BDS 1.26.50.5
Rebuild against that SDK and verify private layouts, symbols and instruction fingerprints on each platform
Build each Python bridge using the Python and pybind11 ABI of the selected Endstone runtime
Run native load, gameplay, persistence and shutdown checks on a disposable server
policy: Endstone dependency has no upper version bound. Private native adapters remain exact-build gated; server fingerprints alone do not establish ABI compatibility.
